objective: Erase every foreground mark from the exact Status-window derived-stats crop and return the same crop as an empty local surface donor. This is strict inpainting, not a redesign and not a transcription task.
reference_role: Reference image 1 is the authoritative source crop. Its exact 180 by 108 canvas and all one-pixel panel boundaries are locked.
preservation_invariants: Keep the exact crop dimensions, pixel density, palette, row geometry, one-pixel separators, borders, and highlights.
Preserve the two derived-stat columns, white row surfaces, thin grey separators, right edge, and lower rule.
All surviving non-semantic pixels must remain at their original coordinates.
canvas: Return this crop only, never the complete game screenshot or magenta desktop.
Render at exactly 720*432 pixels for point reduction back to 180 by 108.
Continue the nearest white, pale-grey, or pale-blue panel surface through every erased foreground pixel.

regions.name: derived-stats
regions.change: Completely remove Atk Def Matk Mdef Hit Flee Critical Aspd Status Point Guild and every number punctuation and value. Leave no readable text, pseudo-text, numbers, arrows, icons, glyph fragments, shadows, or selection tint.
preserve: the two derived-stat columns, white row surfaces, thin grey separators, right edge, and lower rule

style: Exact late-1990s Japanese PC RPG raster UI inpainting
asset_rules: No replacement labels, controls, icons, decoration, or invented panels.
negative_constraints: No readable or gibberish text, digits, arrows, buttons, blue selection, magenta, neighboring windows, smoothing, modern UI, rounded cards, or soft shadows.
quality_checks: OCR at source scale returns no labels or values.
The donor aligns with the source crop boundaries and can be composited without a seam.
Only empty local panel and chrome surfaces remain.
